USPS Accused of Secretly Pursuing Trump's Mail Voting Plan

A whistleblower has alleged that the United States Postal Service (USPS) is secretly proceeding with a mail-voting plan previously proposed by former President Donald Trump. The plan reportedly aims to implement changes to mail sorting and delivery processes before the upcoming midterm elections. The whistleblower's claims suggest that these actions are being taken without public knowledge or full disclosure. One report also mentioned a fact-check concerning warnings about military ballots.
